# kill

Translate the portable HUP, INT and TERM signals.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/kill -l 15
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-l`, `--list` | Translate a supported POSIX signal name or number. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Uses the released async signal API for host signal numbers on Linux and macOS. Arbitrary PID signal delivery and other signal names are unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
